title: Controlling Cloud Costs

header.html: 6.1 Recognize how Google Cloud supports an organization's ability to control their cloud costs: the shift from capital expenditure to operational expenditure and its effect on total cost of ownership; Google-recommended practices for cloud financial governance; people, process and technology; the resource hierarchy; controlling consumption with resource quota policies, budget threshold rules, Cloud Billing reports, Dynamic Workload Scheduler and spot VMs
the official Google Cloud Digital Leader exam guide

html:
1CapEx, OpEx and TCO

Term Meaning
Capital expenditure (CapEx) Large upfront spending on hardware and data centers
Operational expenditure (OpEx) Ongoing pay-as-you-go spending on services
Total cost of ownership (TCO) All costs over time: hardware, space, power, staff, licenses, maintenance

Moving to the cloud shifts CapEx to OpEx: no big upfront purchase, pay for use, scale spending with demand. TCO often falls because the company stops paying for idle capacity, data centers and much of the operations work.

Exam tip

. Cloud = from CapEx to OpEx. TCO is the whole cost, not only the price of servers.

2Cloud financial governance

Financial governance gives predictability and control over cloud costs.

Practice Meaning
Identify who manages cloud costs A named owner or team (often called FinOps)
Use Google Cloud's cost management tools Billing reports, budgets, alerts, quotas
People, process and technology People share cost accountability; processes review and approve spend; technology measures and automates controls

3The resource hierarchy

Level What it is
Organization node The root of the company's resources
Folders Group projects by team, department or environment
Projects The basic container for resources, billing and APIs
Resources Virtual machines, storage buckets, databases and so on
Benefit Meaning
Access control Grant access at a level; it is inherited downward
Inheritance and propagation Policies flow from parents to children
Security and compliance One place to set rules for many projects
Visibility and auditing See and report costs and activity by folder or project

4Controlling consumption

Tool What it does
Resource quota policies Limit how much of a resource can be used (prevents runaway use)
Budget threshold rules Alert people when spending reaches set percentages of a budget
Cloud Billing reports Visualize costs by project, product or label
Dynamic Workload Scheduler Gets accelerator capacity, such as GPUs and TPUs, for AI and batch jobs with flexible scheduling to cost less
Spot VMs Discounted capacity that can be stopped, for fault-tolerant work
Exam tip

. Quotas limit use. Budgets alert on spend. Billing reports show where money goes. A budget alert does not stop spending by itself.

Exam tip

. Cost words in a question: upfront versus ongoing = CapEx and OpEx, alert on spend = budget, limit use = quota, see where money goes = billing reports, cheaper interruptible capacity = spot VMs.

5Exam Q&A

5.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A company stops buying servers and instead pays monthly for the resources it uses. What shift is this?

  • AFrom CapEx to OpEx, with pay-as-you-go costs
  • BFrom OpEx to CapEx, with larger upfront costs
  • CFrom TCO to ROI, with fewer reports
  • DFrom folders to projects, with new quotas
Show the answer

Answer: A. Moving to the cloud replaces large upfront capital spending with ongoing operational spending.

S2Which measure includes hardware, power, staff, licenses and maintenance over time?

  • AMonthly budget alert threshold
  • BTotal cost of ownership
  • CA project quota for virtual machines
  • DA billing report for one folder
Show the answer

Answer: B. Total cost of ownership counts all costs over time, not only purchase prices.

S3A finance team wants an email when spending reaches 80 percent of the monthly plan. Which feature fits?

  • AA resource quota policy
  • BA Cloud Storage lifecycle rule
  • CA load balancer health check
  • DA budget threshold rule
Show the answer

Answer: D. Budget threshold rules alert people when spending reaches set percentages of a budget.

S4A company wants to prevent one project from creating an unlimited number of virtual machines. Which control fits?

  • AA resource quota policy that limits the use
  • BA transparency report from the provider
  • CA dashboard in a business intelligence tool
  • DA sustainability report for the data center
Show the answer

Answer: A. Quota policies limit how much of a resource can be consumed.

S5A company wants to give a team access to all of its projects at once and have the rules inherited by new projects. Where should access be set?

  • AOn every virtual machine one at a time
  • BIn a billing report for each project
  • CIn a spreadsheet of user names
  • DOn a folder in the resource hierarchy
Show the answer

Answer: D. Access set on a folder flows down to the projects and resources inside it.

S6Which people-process-technology practice is part of cloud financial governance?

  • AIdentifying who manages cloud costs and reviewing spend
  • BLetting each employee buy resources freely
  • CHiding cost data from the engineering teams
  • DMoving all costs back to capital expenditure
Show the answer

Answer: A. Financial governance names an owner for costs and uses processes and tools to review spend.

5.2 Recall questions

R1What does moving to the cloud change about spending?

Show the answer

CapEx becomes OpEx.

R2What does TCO include?

Show the answer

All costs over time.

R3What do budget threshold rules do?

Show the answer

Alert at set percentages of a budget.

R4What do quotas do?

Show the answer

Limit how much of a resource can be used.

R5Name the resource hierarchy levels.

Show the answer

Organization, folders, projects, resources.

R6What are spot VMs good for?

Show the answer

Fault-tolerant work at a discount.

6Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Finance CapEx to OpEx; TCO is total cost
Governance owner for costs; people, process, technology
Hierarchy organization, folders, projects, resources; inheritance
Controls quotas (limit), budgets (alert), billing reports (see), DWS and spot VMs (cheaper capacity)
